items.title: Is Nutanix Stock Really Cheap At 11x Earnings?
items.summary: Nutanix (NTNX) closed at $58.94 on Monday, Nov 16, which works out to 11.4 times its reported fiscal 2026 earnings of $5.17 a share. That looks like a bargain for a software company. It is not. About 79.6% of last year's reported profit came from a one-time $1.2 billion tax benefit, and once you take it out the stock trades at 56.7 times earnings.

items.title: Own Sandisk? Your Five Years Hinge On Memory Prices
items.summary: Our Nov 16 piece, What Just Happened To SanDisk Stock?, looked at a 5.6% fall on Friday, Nov 13, that came with no company news. The selling did not stop there. Sandisk fell another 8.6% on Monday, Nov 16, closing at $809.11. The broad market had a bad day too, with the S&P 500 down 1.9%. The stock now sits 65.3% below its record close of $2,335.00 on June 25. That raises the longer question: where could Sandisk be in five years.
